name: Dandelion Parachute Festival
description: People and animals float down from giant dandelions using glowing seed-parachutes in a summer meadow festival.
prompt: A single joyful scene of a whimsical dandelion parachute festival in a vast summer meadow. Giant dandelion heads release fluffy seeds, and tiny people and animals drift down holding glowing seed-parachutes. Picnic blankets, balloons, and flower garlands below. Golden afternoon light, soft breeze, playful storybook illustration style, high detail, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
caption: Gravity takes a day off at the dandelion parachute festival. Who would you float with?
